notes.title: Bhaptics Support
notes.content: Added native integration for the [url=https://www.bhaptics.com/shop/tactvisor/]Tactvisor[/url], [url=https://www.bhaptics.com/shop/tactsuit-x40/]Tactsuit X40[/url] and [url=https://www.bhaptics.com/shop/tactosy-for-arms/]Tactosy for arms[/url] Bhaptics devices

notes.title: Protube Haptic Support
notes.content: Added support for Protube haptic feedback devices such as the [url=https://www.protubevr.com/en/vr-accessories/168-forcetube-haptic-gunstock.html]Forcetube[/url] and [url=https://www.protubevr.com/en/vr-accessories/112-provolver-for-meta-oculus-quest-3.html]Provolver[/url]

notes.title: Joystick Turning Update
notes.content:
Added virtual turning which includes:
-Smooth turning (with a setting to change the speed of rotation)
-Snap turning (with a setting to change the degree of rotation)
-New UI elements for changing turning modes and settings
-New saving system to save turn settings between scenes
Also added:
-Can attempt vault even if feet hits an object you're not touching with your arm
-Improved buggy colliding on grab

notes.title: Weight Distribution Fixes
notes.content:
-Improved how weight is distributed throughout the body
-Changed how the movement input is detected
-Fixed visual bug with lights on city maps
-Fixed player scale
-Fixed slide thresholds on guns
-Fixed the occlusion culling of the external cameras
-Fixed a bug with the recording icon in the menu for the external camera
-Changed how height is detected
-Fixed enemies damaging you when they're dead

notes.title: Court Colliders
notes.content:
-Fixed issues with the collider on the court map
-Fixed slow arm movement

notes.title: Movement Improvements
notes.content:
-Increased jump height
-Increased movement speed
-Improved object weight

notes.title: Updated Manual
notes.content:
-Added more instructions to the manual on how to play the game
-Added a hyperlink for joining the discord server in the start environment

notes.title: New Branding
notes.content: -Added a new logo in the start environment

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed slow ziplining speed in warehouse map
-Fixed revolver recoil breaking when shooting too fast
-Fixed head collisions being too intrusive
-Fixed interactable's colliders being re-enabled too quickly after ungrabbing

notes.title: Post Release Bug Fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug on court with the mesh colliders where you'd bug into colliders and jitter
-Fixed the delayed hand movement
-Fixed the 'cocaine revolver' infinite reloading glitch
-Fixed objects falling through the ground if let go of too quickly
-Fixed slow and stuttery movement
-Fixed hand offset-
-Fixed climbing

notes.title: Updates Notes For Release Day.
notes.content: -Added a part of the manual that explains how to vault over surfaces as some users were confused with this.
